clearance.quote: For safe operation of the Robot fleet, the system needs 600mm (2ft) of clearance above the Grid. There should also be adequate room for service and support staff to safely operate AutoStore service vehicles on top of the Grid: We recommend a minimum height of 2m (6.5ft) of clear space above the Grid.

floors.title: Standard Test Method for Determining FF Floor Flatness and FL Floor Levelness Numbers
floors.note: Written for randomly trafficked floors, which is what a free-roaming fleet produces.
floors.quote: Establish compliance of randomly trafficked floor surfaces with specified FF Flatness and FL Levelness tolerances

floors.title: Standard Test Method for Determining Floor Tolerances Using Waviness, Wheel Path and Levelness Criteria
floors.note: Measures the defined wheel paths a fixed-path vehicle actually runs on.
floors.quote: elevation differences of defined wheel paths

exclusion.quote: Results of this test method shall not be used to enforce contract flatness and levelness tolerances on those floor installations primarily intended to support the operation of fixed-path vehicle systems (for example, narrow aisle warehouse floors).
